banner.title: Cookies on Relier
banner.body: We use analytics and marketing cookies to measure and improve our service and our campaigns. You can turn them off at any time.
banner.policies: More in our <cookies>Cookie Policy</cookies> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

preferences.title: Cookie preferences
preferences.intro: Analytics and marketing cookies are on unless you turn them off. If your browser sends a Global Privacy Control signal, marketing cookies start off. You can change this at any time from Cookie settings, at the foot of every page.

necessary.title: Strictly necessary
necessary.description: Keep the site working: your language, this choice and the booking form. They cannot be turned off.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Google Analytics 4 tells us, in aggregate, which pages are visited and how they are used.

marketing.title: Marketing
marketing.description: Google Ads and the Meta pixel measure our campaigns, and the contact forms remember which campaign brought you here.

map.placeholderLabel: Map of Relier's New York office
map.notice: Loading the map brings in content from Google, and <link>Google's Privacy Policy</link> applies.
